summary: Iteration 17 — End-to-end verification of Phase 2A: CompetitionDetail rewrite, Cart ± / confirmations / top-up flow, Draw Centre (/draw-centre + /draw-results), Header Trophy icon + stripped mobile drawer, Admin Users page new columns + newest-first ordering, Profile tab (username / User ID / DOB read-only / address editable), and PATCH /api/users/me address persistence. Backend: 8/8 new pytest tests pass. Frontend: all UI checks green.
critical_code_review_comments: MyAccount.jsx is 741 lines — should be split by tab (Profile / Wallet / Tickets / KYC / Security / Support / Preferences / Referrals). Beyond the 700-line guideline and will keep growing.

Cart.jsx uses two localStorage keys `gamezoo_cart` (write) and Header.jsx tries both `prizeleague_cart` + `gamezoo_cart` (read). Cart writes only to gamezoo_cart. Consolidate to a single canonical key and provide a one-shot migration to remove ambiguity.

DrawCentre.jsx fetches ALL winners on every mount (up to 200) then filters client-side. For a signed-in user with N tickets, this is O(200 x N) client-side. Prefer a dedicated /api/me/draws endpoint returning only the pending contests + past winners relevant to this user. Not a bug, but a scale concern.

CompetitionDetail.jsx image loading state uses `imgState === 'loading'` initially but the is present with opacity-0 — this works because opacity transitions on onLoad. However, if the contest.image URL is null/empty (e.g. contest not yet uploaded), the src will be '' and neither onLoad nor onError fires reliably in some browsers. Consider defaulting to FALLBACK_IMG when c.image is falsy.
Header.jsx cart-badge polls localStorage every 1500ms with setInterval — cheap but unnecessary re-renders. A single custom storage event on cart-write (or a shared cart context) is cleaner.

Cart.jsx wallet checkout success path navigates to /my-account?tab=tickets — good — but the failure path detects 402 by response.status only. If the backend returns 400 with 'insufficient' in the detail (legacy paths do that in ordersAPI), the redirect to top-up won't trigger. Consider fuzzy-matching the error detail as a fallback.
UsersPage.jsx `list.filter` runs on every keystroke over full users[] (149 rows today, will grow). Fine for MVP but debounce the search or paginate server-side once we cross a few hundred users.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the review-request scenarios exercised (contest detail, cart, draw centre both routes, header trophy + mobile drawer stripped, admin users columns/order/verification pill, profile tab @username + user_id + DOB read-only + address editable & persisted)

rca_of_the_issue:
N/A — feature-verification iteration, no bugs found. Every acceptance criterion in the review request is met:
 • CompetitionDetail: object-contain on #0B0D1F bg, no marketing 3-icon row, status badge (Just launched / Selling fast / Almost full / Closed), %sold shown NOT '3/150', ± controls (1..500), preset chips, summary card with Tickets+Total+Wallet+After-purchase, 7 T&Cs sections (spec asks >=6), Buy → /cart.
 • Cart: minus decrements (does not delete), trash + clear each have confirmation dialogs, sign-in CTA for anon, wallet-preview + top-up CTA for insufficient balance (redirect to /my-account?tab=wallet&topup=1), 402 handler in walletCheckout catch block.
 • Draw Centre: both /draw-centre and /draw-results routes render DrawCentre with tab-pending + tab-results. Anon users see 'Sign in' CTA. Results tab pulls real winners from /api/public/winners. 'Your result' column matches contest-id against user tickets.
 • Header: trophy icon (data-testid=header-draw-centre) between notifications and cart. Mobile drawer for signed-in users has ONLY 'Go to Profile' + big 'Sign Out'. Desktop dropdown ONLY has 'Go to My Profile' + 'Sign Out'.
 • Admin Users: columns Username | User ID | Full name | Email | Phone | DOB | Registered | Verification | KYC | Tickets | Spent | Role | Status — in exact requested order. Sort is newest-first (fresh registration lands in top 5 within 200ms). Verification pill uses verified-yes / verified-no.
 • Profile tab: @username, user_id (mono), DOB (disabled, value=1997-06-15), Address editable, Full name + Email editable, Phone read-only with verified-phone note. PATCH /api/users/me with {address:'...'} returns 200 and GET /me returns the new address.
 • PATCH /api/users/me accepts address field (verified via pytest and via UI Save + GET round-trip).
 • Registration OTP-bypass and email login regression both green.
 • Backend twilio import present and static (server.py line 75); /api/ health returns 200 so import cycle is clean.
